record.original_question: Characterize the congruence lattices, and later the weak congruence lattices, of skew lattices. In particular, determine whether there is a skew-lattice analogue of the classical result that the congruence lattice of a lattice is distributive because of a corresponding Mal'cev term.

evidence.quote: Characterize congruence lattices (and later weak congruence lattices) of skew lattices.
Is there a similar result for skew lattices?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A skew lattice is an algebra (S; ∧, ∨) of type (2,2) where both ∧ and ∨ are associative and idempotent and satisfy the absorption identities x ∧ (x ∨ y) = x = x ∨ (x ∧ y) and (x ∧ y) ∨ y = y = (x ∨ y) ∧ y. A congruence on S is an equivalence relation compatible with ∧ and ∨; the set Con(S) of all congruences, ordered by inclusion, forms an algebraic lattice. A weak congruence on S is an equivalence relation on a subalgebra of S that is a congruence on that subalgebra; the collection CW(S) of all weak congruences, ordered by inclusion, forms an algebraic lattice that contains Con(S) and the subalgebra lattice Sub(S) as natural sublattices.

(a) Give an intrinsic characterization, up to isomorphism, of the class of lattices that arise as Con(S) for some skew lattice S.

(b) Give an intrinsic characterization, up to isomorphism, of the class of lattices that arise as CW(S) for some skew lattice S.

(c) It is classical that for every (ordinary) lattice L, Con(L) is a distributive lattice, and this fact is witnessed by a Mal'cev-style ternary term (i.e., the variety of lattices is congruence-distributive via Jónsson terms). Determine whether the variety of skew lattices, or some natural subvariety such as strongly distributive skew lattices, satisfies an analogous Mal'cev-type condition forcing structural properties (e.g. distributivity, modularity, or a weaker identity) of Con(S) for every skew lattice S in the variety; if so, exhibit such terms and the resulting property of Con(S).
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of characterizing congruence lattices (and weak congruence lattices) of skew lattices, together with the question of a Mal'cev-type witness for properties of their congruence lattices, is posed as an open problem in the noncommutative-structures community and recent work on skew lattices (e.g., on coset structure and distributivity) addresses related structural aspects but does not provide a full characterization. No published solution was found.

status_evidence.title: Open problems from NCS 2018
status_evidence.snippet: Characterize congruence lattices (and later weak congruence lattices) of skew lattices. Is there a similar result for skew lattices?
status_evidence.claim: The characterization of congruence lattices of skew lattices and the existence of a Mal'cev-type analogue are listed as open problems.

status_evidence.title: On the coset structure of distributive skew lattices
status_evidence.snippet: Recent investigations of distributivity and cancellation for skew lattices, presenting characterizations for categorical skew lattices and descriptions of coset structures.
status_evidence.claim: Recent research addresses related structural properties of skew lattices but not a full characterization of their congruence lattices.
